steps.tip: Deputy Willem stands on the path in front of the Abbey. Kill wolves and kobolds as you go; everything here is quick.

steps.prof: Riley Peltskinner next to Eagan is the new junior Skinning trainer; Nancy Songflower (east of the Abbey) teaches Herbalism and Kelsey Fargo at Echo Ridge teaches Mining. Learning one now is free XP time later.

steps.tip: Kobold Vermin are in the field north of the Abbey. Kobolds here can drop a Nibbled-On Book; it starts a new Forever chain, so loot everything.
New in Forever: the Nibbled-On Book drops from Northshire kobolds.
Timber Wolves and Young Wolves roam the meadows around the Abbey. Meat drops are not guaranteed.
McBride hands out your class letter once the kobold camp is cleared. Read it and take it to your trainer.
New in Forever: Humans can be Hunters. Tordrin Sternblade waits by the stable behind the Abbey.
Warlocks: the Powers of the Void tome sits by the Defias tents east of the Abbey. Do it with the bandana quest.

steps.text: Train your level 2 spells while you are in the Abbey

steps.tip: Kobold Workers fill the field north of the Abbey. Stolen Books drop from any kobold here, so keep killing until both are done.
Defias Thugs camp in the vineyard east of the Abbey. Bandanas don't drop every kill.
The book pile is by the tents at the north end of the Thug camp.
The crates sit between the vines in the Thug vineyard.
Garrick Padfoot stands by the cottage at the east end of the vineyard with two Thugs. Pull the guards first.
Kelsey Fargo waits at the Echo Ridge Mine entrance. She is also the junior Mining trainer.
Kobold Laborers fill Echo Ridge Mine. Shinyfinder Narf is deep inside; loot his sack of books.
New in Forever: this sends you to Sam, the Camping 101 teacher near Goldshire. Free XP on the way.
Priests: you need level 5 for this. It sends you to Priestess Josetta in Goldshire.
Falkhaan stands on the road south out of the valley.
Click the kobold tracks along the road south toward Goldshire.
Set your hearthstone here; Goldshire is the hub for the rest of the zone.
Sam sits at a campfire just north-east of Goldshire.
Sit by the fire until the Boosted Rest buff shows.
New in Forever: every Camping 101 path is exclusive. Cooking is the useful pick for everyone; choose your own profession's version instead if you have one.

steps.text: Talk to Tomas the cook in Goldshire and turn in Camping 101: Cooking

steps.tip: The traps float along the west shore of Crystal Lake, just east of Goldshire.
Heal Guard Roberts with Lesser Heal rank 2, then buff him with Fortitude.
The murloc huts are on the east shore. Junk piles sit between the huts; grab them while you kill.
Head south-west down the road to the Stonefield Farm.
Stonetusk Boars roam the fields between the two farms.
Duskweed grows in the fields around the farms; boars also drop the Animal Blood. 18 petals take a while, so do it while you kill boars.
Fargodeep Mine is just north of the Maclure vineyard. Entering it also completes The Fargodeep Mine. Kobolds drop both Gold Dust and Candles.
Nimsy is a named kobold near the mine; the Lost Books drop from the kobolds inside.
Goldtooth sits in the lower part of the mine. Clear your way down; he is a level 8 kobold.
Back to Goldshire.

segments.title: Eastern Elwynn: Tower of Azora, Eastvale and Jasperlode

steps.tip: Kelp comes from the Crystal Lake murlocs on your way east.
Hamish is in the Tower of Azora, south of the road.
Head north to Jasperlode Mine. Geomancers are deeper in; they cast, so fight them in melee range. Walking in also completes The Jasperlode Mine.
Geosculptor Yip and Mother Fang are inside Jasperlode; Mother Fang is a level 10 spider.
Back to the tower for the follow-up; its wizards are near Rolf's murloc village, which you visit next anyway.
Wood bundles lie in the hills north of the logging camp.
Prowlers and bears share the hills around the camp.
Follow the river north; the body lies on the west bank.
Rolf lies in the murloc village further north. Pull carefully; murlocs come in packs.
Defias Rogue Wizards camp north of Stone Cairn Lake, west of the murloc village.
Bandanas drop from the Rogue Wizards and other Defias here.
The supply piles sit in the gnoll camps west of Stone Cairn Lake.
The mining tools lie near the Jasperlode Mine entrance. Walking into the mine also completes The Jasperlode Mine.
South again to the Tower of Azora.
Princess is the big boar in the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch with two pigs. Pull her alone if you can.
The tools washed down the river south of the bridge.
Hearth back to Goldshire instead of walking west.
This one goes back to Sara in the logging camp; you return east later on the balanced route.
This sends you to Sentinel Hill in Westfall; keep it for the next pack.
steps.text: Accept Report to Gryan Stoutmantle from Marshal Dughan
Train level 10 spells and pick up your class quest

steps.tip: New in Forever: Human Hunters learn to tame from Josephine Carson in Goldshire.
Rockhide Boars roam south of Goldshire toward the Maclure farm. Use the Taming Rod on one.
Gray Forest Wolves prowl east of Crystal Lake.
Young Forest Bears wander the woods south-west of the Tower of Azora.
Maybell is at the Maclure farm south of Goldshire.
Ma Stonefield is at the farm to the west, on the way to Westbrook.
Westbrook Garrison sits on the road west of Goldshire.

steps.elite: Hogger is an elite level 11 gnoll with others around him. Bring a friend, or skip it.

steps.tip: Riverpaw gnolls fill Forest's Edge south of the garrison.

steps.elite: Hogger walks the south end of Forest's Edge. Pull him away from the other gnolls.

steps.tip: Stormwind's gate is north of Westbrook. Morgan Pestle is in the Trade District.
Grab the Stormwind flight path in Old Town; Westfall's quests fly you back here.
Warriors: Harry Burlguard is in the Pig and Whistle in Old Town.
Beat Bartleby; he gives up at low health.
Rogues: Mathias Shaw is in SI:7 in Old Town. Snatch and Grab's dockmaster is at Jerod's Landing; turn it in on your next city visit.
Warlocks: Gakin is in the Slaughtered Lamb cellar in the Mage Quarter.
Mages: Jennea Cannon is in the Wizard's Sanctum in the Mage Quarter.
Mirror Lake is just outside the city gate to the south-west. Use the empty vial at the waterfall.
Surena Caledon is in the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch in eastern Elwynn. It is a long walk, but this unlocks your Voidwalker.
Summon the Voidwalker with the choker in Gakin's cellar and beat it.
Rogues: the Defias Dockmaster stands on Jerod's Landing south-east of Maclure. Turn it in on your next Stormwind visit.

steps.text: Grind Riverpaw gnolls at Forest's Edge to 12 on the way to Westfall
steps.speed: Skip the grind if you already killed everything on the way; Westfall's first quests are fine at 11.

steps.tip: From the city, head to Northshire Abbey and hand Brother Paxton his books.
Marshal Dughan in Goldshire takes Hogger's claw.
Guard Thomas has a new bounty now that his report is delivered.
Warlocks: Surena Caledon is in the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch; her choker unlocks your Voidwalker.
Warriors: Marshal Haggard lives at the farm at the far east end of Elwynn.
Dead-tooth Jack's camp is south-east of the farm; the badge is in his strongbox.
Murlocs line the river south of the bridge. Fins drop about every other kill.
Hearth if it is off cooldown; otherwise run west along the road.
Warlocks: back to Gakin in Stormwind.
Summon the Voidwalker with the choker in Gakin's cellar and beat it.
Maybell is at the Maclure farm south of Goldshire.
Rogues: the Defias Dockmaster stands on Jerod's Landing south-east of the Maclure farm, with a bodyguard. Turn it in on your next Stormwind visit.
Ma Stonefield is at the farm west of Maclure.

steps.text: Top off to level 12 on Defias Bandits west of Goldshire if you are short
tip: Bandits drop Red Linen; head west over the bridge into Westfall when you are 12.
Paladins: at 12, Brother Wilhelm in Goldshire starts the Tome of Divinity chain (Duthorian Rall in Stormwind); pick it up when you next pass through.
